name: Shallum
overview: Shallum is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Bani. A notable aspect of his identity is that he had married a foreign wife, which is explicitly mentioned in Scripture. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Shallum means 'peace, well-being, prosperity.' It is a proper name and was not given directly by God. This meaning reflects positive attributes but no special divine naming is indicated.
familyAndRelationships: Shallum is explicitly recorded as a descendant of Bani. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further details about his family or other relationships.
scriptureSignificance: Shallum's significance lies in his mention in the context of intermarriage with foreign wives, a matter addressed in the post-exilic community as recorded in Ezra. His example illustrates the challenges faced by returning Israelites in maintaining covenantal purity. This highlights the community's efforts to renew faithfulness to God's commands during restoration.
